1 (Currently amended): A cleanable, waterborne polyurethane dispersion comprising the reaction product of: A) one or more OH-functional acrylic dispersions and B) one or more polyisocyanates modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid.

2 (Currently amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component A) comprises at least two distinct OH-functional acrylic dispersions.

3 (Currently amended): The dispersion of claim 1, wherein component B) comprises at least one polyisocyanate modified with 3-(cyclohexylamino)-propanesulfonic acid derived from an aliphatic diisocyanate.

4 (Original): The dispersion of claim 3, wherein the aliphatic diisocyanate is 1,6-diisocyanatohexane.

5 (Original): A method of producing a cleanable coating on a substrate comprising applying the dispersion of claim 1 to the substrate and curing the coating composition.

6 (Original): A coating produced according to the method of claim 5.

7 (Original): The coating of claim 6, wherein the surface energy of the coating is greater than 31.0 dynes/cm.

8 (Currently amended): The coating of claim 7, wherein the surface roughness of the coating is defined as a root mean square roughness greater than 200 nm.
